defold/extension-photon-fusion/fusion

Functions and constants for interacting with Photon Fusion

  • GitHub: defold/extension-photon-fusion — pinned to 1.0 (released while Defold 1.13.1 was current)
    1. Pick a release from defold/extension-photon-fusion releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

fusion.create_map_object(map: number, owner_mode: number, options: table, id?: string)

Create a map object.

Parameters

  • map: number
  • owner_mode: number
  • options: table — Table with properties and replication_mode fields. The properties field should be a id,property map with script ids and properties to sync. Replication mode should be one of the established REPLICATION_MODE constants.
  • id?: string

fusion.spawn(factory_url: string, position: vector3 | undefined, rotation: quat | undefined, map: number, owner_mode: number, options: table): hash

Create a networked game object. This will spawn a game object in the same. Way as when calling factory.create(). The function will also register the spawned object with Fusion as if manually calling register_object()

Parameters

  • factory_url: string
  • position: vector3 | undefined — Initial position of created game object
  • rotation: quat | undefined — Initial rotation of created game object
  • map: number — The map to which this object belongs
  • owner_mode: number — Owner mode of spawned object
  • options: table — Table with properties and replication_mode fields. The properties field should be a id,property map with script ids and properties to sync. Replication mode should be one of the established REPLICATION_MODE constants.

Returns

  • id: hash — Id of the spawned game object

fusion.send_rpc(target_player: number, target_object: hash, event: hash, data?: table): boolean

Send an RPC event. Events can be sent to a specific player or all players, and. To a specific object or to all subscribers.

Parameters

  • target_player: number — 0 = all, specific PlayerId = targeted
  • target_object: hash — Id of game object, nil for broadcast
  • event: hash
  • data?: table

Returns

  • ok: boolean

fusion.set_room_send_rate(send_rate: number, id?: string)

Set the send rate of an object. This decided how much bandwidth to allocate

Parameters

  • send_rate: number
  • id?: string — Id of the object to send rate for

fusion.set_local_send_rate(send_rate: number, id?: string)

Set the local send rate divisor for an object. A value of 1 means the object sends every tick (highest rate). A value of 16 means it sends every 16th tick (lowest rate). This is a client-side optimization -- the object still exists on all clients but consumes less bandwidth when you are not the active authority.

Parameters

  • send_rate: number
  • id?: string — Id of the object to send rate for

fusion.reset_room_send_rate(id?: string)

Reset the send rate of an object.

Parameters

  • id?: string — Id of the object to reset send rate for
